info.title: Basstok API
info.description: Basstok's external HTTP contract: Content with Comments, Chats with Messages, optional Labels, Members, and Assets. Collection POST creates return Basstok-assigned canonical IDs; item paths address existing resources. Queries filter or page representations. Successful ordinary activity mutations (existing Content edits without Label changes, Comments, reactions, follows, Messages and notification state) acknowledge live resident state and may precede durable storage. Notifications, email and webhooks may follow that acceptance without waiting for storage. Unflushed activity may be lost after a service process or compute failure, even after external delivery. Retry identity is retained while resident and after persistence; loss of unflushed activity may also lose its retry result. Security, permissions, authentication, storage changes, resource publication, import completion and scheduled-operation success retain durable acknowledgement. No imported hierarchy, audit mechanics, storage layout, or client framework leaks into this model.

post.description: DEC-DNS-PROVIDER-COPY. Current human Admin, exact verified claim and selected connection, with no pending provider work. Reads a complete bounded inventory (100 records), full-zone binding, DNS settings and DNSSEC. Proxied, configured-flattened, DNSSEC-enabled, child-delegated, unsupported or malformed data fails the whole copy. DNS records only: Cloudflare services are not transferred. Same tenant/session/browser-presence/no-store/bounded-admission and OAuth refresh rules as inspection. No provider writes or automatic retry. Returns a transient proposed first zone revision and comparison digest; no persisted preview or publication.

put.summary: Schedule a bounded batch of existing API mutations
put.description: Delegated applications only. No separate scheduling scope: every request requires its ordinary write scope. Supports PUT member-creations/{id}, PUT content-drafts/{id}, POST content-drafts/{id}/publish, PUT contents/{id}/comment-creations/{id}, POST chats, and POST chats/{id}/messages under /api/v1/. Chat and Message POSTs require idempotency_key, which supplies their ordinary Idempotency-Key header. No arbitrary headers, hosts, query parameters, edits, nested schedules or other operations. Times use UTC YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ and must be nondecreasing and in the future, with no application-defined future scheduling horizon. The timestamp format supports four-digit years through 9999; a new batch cannot predate its admission's current UTC second. Up to 8192 requests per batch, 16384 retained requests and 32 batches per community, 64 KiB per body, and 16 MiB total request data. Each exact request is authorized against the current Grant, responsible Member, persona and resource. Unrelated scope or Label additions do not invalidate execution. Stored admission snapshots never confer authority. Identical submission retries return current progress; changing a running batch returns 409. Pause the batch to replace its unattempted tail with future requests under the same ID. The exact completed prefix and any currently attempted request, including its time, are immutable. Replacement keeps the batch paused and does not reset attempts. Completed records retain identity for at least seven days from actual completion; cancelled records from cancellation.

A terminal error is not a promise that an earlier ambiguous attempt never committed. Creation identities prevent duplicating the underlying creation on recovery. Exact execution time is not guaranteed; requests are never intentionally executed before their due time.

HTTP 202 acknowledges input in the current attempt, not import success or a durable progress checkpoint. HistoricalMembers.description: Historical Member identities with optional account emails. No credentials, App control, Basstok terms consent, blocks, deletion requests or notification preferences may be imported.

HistoricalAssetBatch.description: At most 32 MiB decoded payload bytes in total, with distinct Asset IDs. Validated before bounded parallel uploads; same-owner admission remains serialized. The recipe digest hashes the compact ordered descriptor array (id, name, media_type, size, created_at, updated_at, owner), excluding sha256 and payload_base64. Absent timestamps are null. Exact full-body identity still governs duplicate acknowledgement. Received payload digests are independently verified; optional media bytes are established by upload rather than recipe preview.

title_identity_segment.description: Optional zero-based segment where an imported numeric identity accepts an arbitrary legacy title prefix. The stored segment contains the numeric identity alone.

preferred.description: Select this exact Content page path for generated links and SEO canonical URLs. At most one preferred alias per Content and Comment-page offset. Other aliases remain directly usable.

HistoricalRoute.description: An exact legacy public route. Page offsets, page size and Comment targets preserve pagination and deep links. System-owned routes, including Home, are not importable.

assignments.description: Explicitly assigned baselines only, including missing or drifted records. matches is a fresh observation, not authority or a persisted external-edit reconciliation loop. Provider account/zone bindings remain internal.

pending_creation.description: One durably admitted creation awaiting confirmation, mutually exclusive with assignment pending updates. The identity becomes the assignment ID only after confirmation. Missing records do not authorize replay. Provider binding and marker metadata stay internal.

CloudflareDnsRecordInput.description: Values for a new record; no provider ID, credentials or marker can be selected. Apex NS is not creatable. Proxied records use automatic TTL, and the ordinary DNS value/type bounds apply.

pending_update.description: Exact durably admitted but unconfirmed DNS change, at most one per claim. For update, record is the intended value; for delete, it is the unchanged assigned baseline being removed. Do not resubmit or release until reconciled.

CloudflareDnsRecord.description: Provider-shaped DNS values used for observations, assigned baselines and explicit updates. TTL 1 is automatic. A, AAAA and CNAME require proxied; only MX includes priority; CAA includes data. An ID grants no mutation authority.

authorization_url.description: Scoped provider URL with PKCE challenge, never the verifier or client secret.

return_url.description: Required server-selected hosting HTTPS origin plus /oauth/cloudflare/return, without query or fragment; never caller-selected.

available.description: The hosting cell has usable OAuth application configuration.

connected.description: The canonical claim selects an active private provider credential, including an expired access token that has not consumed its refresh. False for consumed refresh or disconnecting credentials. An uncertain refresh requires reconnection, not replay; finish any revocation_pending cleanup before reconnecting. This does not verify domain ownership, effective DNS-writing authority, current provider access, Internet DNS or deliverability.

revocation_pending.description: Known stored credentials are durably disabled but their provider revocation/cleanup has not finished. Explicitly retry DELETE before starting new authorization. False does not prove provider-wide revocation of tokens Basstok never received.

native_dns.description: Derived native handoff status for this exact claim. Prepared DNS is not_active. After canonical native activation, cleanup_required means saved Cloudflare credentials or a current authorization attempt remain, including consumed credentials and attempts initiated by another Admin. Complete means those local bindings are cleared, not proof of provider-wide revocation, present Internet delegation, TLS or email readiness. Use the existing explicit DELETE to finish cleanup; it never deletes provider records.

authorization.description: Present only for the initiating Member's unexpired authorization attempt.

CertificateValidationPending.description: Engine retains an incomplete certificate DNS proof lifecycle for this exact claim, including after restart or disconnection. Ordinary record mutations remain blocked while true. Read status or inspect records again to observe progress; reconnect the original account/zone if needed. Neither value proves certificate issuance, HTTPS readiness, or provider cleanup. Reading does not retry writes or create a CA order.

address.description: Numeric IPv4 text only; no byte arrays, embedded NUL, whitespace or trailing junk.
Numeric IPv6 text only; no byte arrays, zone IDs, brackets, embedded NUL, whitespace or trailing junk.

target.description: Exact DNS name, not a relative name or @ shorthand. Unescaped ASCII labels (letters, digits, hyphen, underscore), at most 63 bytes each and 255 bytes expanded wire name; optional trailing dot, case-insensitive. A wildcard is allowed only as the complete leftmost label. Root '.' only where explicitly allowed.

exchange.description: Exact DNS name, not a relative name or @ shorthand. Unescaped ASCII labels (letters, digits, hyphen, underscore), at most 63 bytes each and 255 bytes expanded wire name; optional trailing dot, case-insensitive. A wildcard is allowed only as the complete leftmost label. Root '.' only where explicitly allowed. Root '.' means null MX, requires preference 0 and must be the only MX. In-zone MX targets cannot be CNAMEs.

items.description: At most 255 bytes per character string, including empty strings. Bound is bytes, not Unicode characters.

strings.description: Preserve character-string boundaries and values; never flatten or split implicitly.

value.description: Preserved exactly. Encoded CAA RDATA (flags, tag length, tag and value) must not exceed 4096 bytes.

target.description: Exact DNS name, not a relative name or @ shorthand. Unescaped ASCII labels (letters, digits, hyphen, underscore), at most 63 bytes each and 255 bytes expanded wire name; optional trailing dot, case-insensitive. A wildcard is allowed only as the complete leftmost label. Root '.' only where explicitly allowed. Non-root target. NS records exist only at the exact zone apex; child delegation is unsupported. In-zone targets cannot be CNAMEs.

primary.description: Exact DNS name, not a relative name or @ shorthand. Unescaped ASCII labels (letters, digits, hyphen, underscore), at most 63 bytes each and 255 bytes expanded wire name; optional trailing dot, case-insensitive. A wildcard is allowed only as the complete leftmost label. Root '.' only where explicitly allowed. Non-root; native publication requires membership in the exact installation-controlled apex NS set.

mailbox.description: Exact DNS name, not a relative name or @ shorthand. Unescaped ASCII labels (letters, digits, hyphen, underscore), at most 63 bytes each and 255 bytes expanded wire name; optional trailing dot, case-insensitive. A wildcard is allowed only as the complete leftmost label. Root '.' only where explicitly allowed. Non-root DNS mailbox name, not an email address.

owner.description: Exact DNS name, not a relative name or @ shorthand. Unescaped ASCII labels (letters, digits, hyphen, underscore), at most 63 bytes each and 255 bytes expanded wire name; optional trailing dot, case-insensitive. A wildcard is allowed only as the complete leftmost label. Root '.' only where explicitly allowed. Must equal the exact zone apex or a descendant at a DNS-label boundary; SOA and NS owners must equal the apex.

DnsApiRecord.description: A typed DNS record. Entire proposed zone is validated: exactly one apex SOA and a nonempty apex NS RRset; no duplicate records, inconsistent RRset TTLs or CNAME coexistence. At most one SPF TXT policy per case-insensitive owner: concatenate character strings within each record without spaces, then match case-insensitive v=spf1 followed by space or end. This is not SPF evaluation or sending-provider approval. CNAME chains have at most 16 hops and no cycles; at most 64 records and 8192 encoded bytes per RRset, 4096 bytes per RDATA, 8192 nodes and 1 MiB encoded snapshot. Native publication requires the apex NS set to match verified parent delegation and SOA primary to belong to that set; replacement preserves both delegation identities.

records.description: Full explicit proposed record set, not a patch. Caller is responsible for retaining wanted TXT, MX and other existing records.
Full explicit proposed record set, not a patch. Caller is responsible for retaining wanted TXT, MX and other existing records.

apex.description: Canonical lowercase exact zone apex without trailing dot.

records.description: The established canonical record set, without provider credentials or private proof state.

items.description: Canonical lowercase fully qualified ASCII hostname, without trailing dot, wildcard or IP literal; labels have at most 63 bytes.

native_nameservers.description: Installation-configured native nameserver list; empty when native publication is disabled. This is not caller-selected proof or authority.

apex.description: Canonical lowercase DNS zone apex without a trailing dot. basstok.com is available only to the hosting Organization.

verification_value.description: Exactly basstok-dns= followed by id, a colon and the decimal generation.

endpoint.description: Public HTTPS origin without a trailing slash, path, query, fragment or embedded credentials.

bucket.description: Dedicated private S3 bucket; adjacent periods, period-hyphen combinations and IPv4-address names are rejected.

OrganizationSystemLabels.description: The Organization's optional fixed audience Label. At most one audience may be present.

MemberSystemLabels.description: Fixed Member state: independent supporter status and at most one authority role.

comment_count.description: Visible Comments in this collection presentation; derived from the owning Content aggregate.

attribution.description: Optional human-readable attribution naming the application that created this no-login persona Member.

MemberHandle.description: DEC-MEMBER-HANDLE: required canonical, Organization-unique, immutable lowercase ASCII handle. Public profile URL /@{handle}; stable Member IDs remain API and relationship identities.

handle.description: Optional on creation: omission lets Engine generate a lowercase ASCII display-name slug bounded to 31 characters, falling back to member; a collision appends - plus the first 16 hexadecimal digits of SHA-256 of the Member ID. If that spelling is reserved too, a numeric suffix selects an available spelling within the 48-character bound. Invalid handles return 400 and duplicate explicit handles return 409. On update, omission preserves the existing handle; a differing handle returns 409.

description.description: Optional public CommonMark profile text, limited to 4096 UTF-8 bytes. Omission or null produces an absent description.

avatar.description: An authorized image Asset owned by this community. Omit to preserve the current avatar, or use null to remove it. Other resources’ attachments cannot be used as avatars.

member_id.description: Present only for a Member-authored Message, including explicit outgoing phone messages and personal email. External email, incoming phone texts and faxes never authenticate or impersonate a Member.

attribution.description: Optional human-readable intermediary attribution. Canonical audit mechanics are not part of the resource contract.

TelnyxSmsEvent.description: Signed provider envelope. Authentication precedes strict bounded parsing; additional provider metadata cannot confer authority.

MessageSms.description: Customer-carrier cellular SMS provenance, not SIP MESSAGE. The sender may be a phone number, short code or alphanumeric external label and is not an authenticated Basstok identity. Provider IDs and private credential selectors are not disclosed.

text.description: Derived plain-text rendering of canonical Message.body, retaining line layout. Not independently stored.

MessageSip.description: DecisionId: DEC-PHONE-SIP-MESSAGE. Calling-account SIP MESSAGE provenance, distinct from cellular SMS. External sender addresses are untrusted and confer no Member identity. Private connection selectors and replay hashes are omitted. Accepted reports submission acceptance only, never sent/delivered proof.

text.description: Derived plain text from canonical Message.body, retaining line layout. May be empty, including for newline-only input. Not independently stored and not subject to the 1024-byte sending-input bound; canonical body limits are separate.

MessageFax.description: DecisionId: DEC-PHONE-FAX. Fax provenance and document receipt. Exactly one ordinary Chat-owned PDF Asset contains the document; sender addresses are untrusted external labels, never Member identity. Received SIP addresses may retain numeric hosts, ports and ordinary routing parameters; they are presentation, not permission or an automatically valid dial target. Private connection/receiving selectors and replay/document proofs are omitted. This read representation does not imply that fax sending or reception is available on a connection.

sip_message_available.description: DecisionId: DEC-PHONE-SIP-MESSAGE. True only while the active registered runtime line matches the selected account and current storage generation. Allows submission, not proof of provider SIP MESSAGE support, cellular SMS support or delivery. Existing idempotent results remain readable while false.

fax_receiving_supported.description: DecisionId: DEC-PHONE-FAX. The serving cell has its explicit encrypted-audio/T.38 receiving transport configured and running. This is not proof of provider fax compatibility, NAT/firewall reachability or successful document receipt. Current registration is independent. False prevents enabling, but never prevents disabling an existing selection.

fax_sending_available.description: DecisionId: DEC-PHONE-FAX. Submission is available only with configured/running fax transport and a registered exact calling connection in the current storage generation. This is not a guarantee of free line capacity, provider fax support or delivery. Receiving selection is independent; exact previously admitted results remain readable while false.

registration.description: not_connected means no selected account; connecting means an active registration attempt; reconnecting means a bounded automatic retry is pending; registered means an accepted provider registration, not proven media or device readiness; unavailable requires explicit recovery.

address.description: SIP account address; not a verified Member identity.

fax_receiving_enabled.description: DecisionId: DEC-PHONE-FAX. Explicit Admin selection for the current connection, not a carrier-readiness claim. Private receiving generations never appear in REST.

recipient.description: Explicit international E.164 number or strict sip:user@domain. A telephone number uses the selected provider domain; no display names, parameters, headers, ports, address lists or password-bearing URIs.

pages.description: Ordered, client-rendered fax pages. At most 16777216 decoded pixel bytes across the whole document.

resolution.description: Horizontal density is 80.4 pixels/cm. Vertical density is 38.5 pixels/cm for standard and 77 pixels/cm for fine. Preserve document aspect ratio when rendering.

pixels_base64.description: Canonical padded RFC 4648 base64, without line breaks. Decodes to exactly width/8 * height bytes, rows from top to bottom, pixels from left to right, most-significant bit first. A set bit is black; a clear bit is white. These exact pixels become the immutable canonical PDF, not the source file or an arbitrary pre-existing Asset.

port.description: Explicit registrar TLS port. No UDP or plaintext fallback.

realm.description: Exact provider authentication realm; printable ASCII excluding quote and backslash. Empty uses the registrar hostname. This does not change the SIP address, TLS hostname, destination or provider identity.

registrar.description: Canonical lowercase DNS hostname with at least two labels and one letter, without wildcard or trailing dot.

remote_address.description: Incoming: untrusted external caller presentation. Outgoing: explicitly selected E.164 destination. Never Member identity.

member_id.description: Local answering/initiating human Member, not a device identifier or proof of endpoint ownership.

answer_token.description: Private single-call TLS proof, never reusable login. Empty on an exact Live retry; do not persist or log.

tls_certificate_pem.description: Current signaling listener's exact leaf certificate, obtained only through authenticated HTTPS. The native endpoint verifies this exact certificate, hostname and validity before sending its one-call proof. This is transient delegation for this answer/dial attempt, not a reusable CA store or account credential; discard with the attempt.

can_send.description: Provider reports sending capability; does not certify delivery or waive customer compliance.

webhook_url.description: Visible only to a current Manager participant. Advanced/manual fallback URL for a dedicated customer messaging profile.

ChatPhoneSetup.description: DecisionId: DEC-PHONE-TELNYX-SETUP. Omitted for disconnected Chats and anyone except a current human Manager participant with a selected number. Read-only provider inspection; not authorization to mutate or proof of receiving readiness.

state.description: unavailable: inspection could not verify safe setup; provider_action: complete provider setup manually; shared_profile: isolate this number from other number or short-code use; available: explicit setup may be requested; configured: expected receiving settings are verified, but receive_state still requires a real incoming test.

body.description: Plain UTF-8 text, at most 1600 Unicode scalars and 6400 bytes; normalized to literal CommonMark in history. Customer carrier segmentation/charges apply.

recipient.description: Explicit international E.164 number or sip:user@domain, validated and normalized by Engine; no display names, URI parameters, headers or caller-selected transport.

connection_id.description: Exact current SMTP selection, or empty when no SMTP selection exists.

recipient.description: One plain ASCII address, without display name or header syntax.

subject.description: At most 512 UTF-8 bytes, without control characters; may be empty.

body.description: Meaningful plain UTF-8 text, at most 16384 bytes. Rendered as escaped Markdown in Chat; not HTML.

MessageOutgoingEmail.description: Immutable authored email content with explicit provider-submission status. Existing Chat/history authorization applies; never accepted by ordinary Message-write operations.

message_id.description: Stable outgoing RFC Message-ID without angle brackets.

status.description: Acceptance is not delivery. Unconfirmed is never automatically resubmitted.

text.description: Derived plain-text rendering of the canonical Message body, retaining line layout. Not separately stored.

MessageEmail.description: Untrusted external correspondence received at this Chat's enabled address. Claimed headers grant no Member identity, authority or access to Chat history. MIME attachments appear in the containing Message's ordinary assets list and inherit its Chat/history authorization. Not accepted by Message write operations.

authorize_url.description: Fixed selected-provider authorization origin, read-only mail scopes and state/S256 PKCE; not a Basstok login. Validate the URL against the provider selected by the endpoint.

return_url.description: Exact hosting HTTPS browser return, without query/fragment; callback redirect adds only target_organization_id, chat_id, authorization_id and result. method.description: Recommended connection method for this address. Google and Microsoft consent never ask for a mailbox password.

google_available.description: Configured Google consent may also be selected explicitly for custom Google Workspace addresses; this is not proof of provider readiness.

microsoft_available.description: Configured Microsoft consent may also be selected explicitly for custom Microsoft 365 addresses; this is not proof of provider readiness.

can_manage.description: Current human creator and participant; not Organization Manager authority.

domains.description: Sorted, unique published Organization domain candidates; empty for non-creators. Includes only this tenant's exact active managed hostname when the hosting apex is published.

receiving_available.description: The serving installation has an incoming SMTP listener. Does not establish Internet reachability, public MX routing or successful mail delivery.

mx_host.description: Installation SMTP hostname. After exact-address activation, set the receiving domain's MX to this hostname with priority 10. Domain-wide cutover must be deliberate; unconnected recipients are rejected.

incoming_email_address.description: Optional enabled receiving address for this Chat. Sharing it permits incoming correspondence only, never reading Chat history or impersonating a Member.

phone_number.description: Customer-owned number connected for cellular texts. Inspect the phone resource for current readiness; this field does not promise calling support.

creator_id.description: Optional no-login persona Member created and still controlled by this application for the responsible human Member. The selected creator must be included in participant_ids. Selecting an existing controlled Member does not require member:write.

optional_notifications_enabled.description: Whether optional notification email is enabled for this Account.

PushRegistration.description: Current Member-owned device metadata; the provider token and exact-session binding remain private.

content_label_ids.description: Ordinary Label identities selecting the Content resources available to this grant.

csrf.description: The value of the matching browser-presence cookie.

grant_id.description: The current Application Grant identity used when registering webhooks.

actor_id.description: Present for a Chat reference delivered for a selected controlled Member. Use the same actor_id when dereferencing the Chat so its participant and admission boundary are applied.

post.description:
Bounded signed change signal. Require the Basstok-Webhook-Id header to equal payload.id and Basstok-Webhook-Timestamp to equal payload.occurred_at. Verify Basstok-Webhook-Signature as lowercase hex HMAC-SHA256 using the subscription signing secret over the exact UTF-8 bytes `v1
<delivery-id>
<timestamp>
<body>`, where body is the request body exactly as received. Deduplicate by delivery ID, then re-read authorized current state.
